notes: HondaECU repository supplies the 2012 US XDF and a 2012–2013 38770-MGP-A01 stock image. The offline builder accepts only the exact source-image and XDF hashes. ECU hardware identity and physical programming are not established by a file hash.

session.physical_blocked_reason: Honda diagnostic and programming sessions are not implemented.

memory.write_blocked_reason: Offline image editing does not implement ECU programming.
